summary.diagnosis:
*Oct 5→Oct 11 vs Sep 28→Oct 4* · Revenue -12% (1,063,644 vs 1,209,502 EGP) · Spend +12% · ROAS 4.78 (-22%).
   • CPC: 2.36 → 2.43 EGP (+3%, ~flat)
   • CVR: 1.13% → 1.05% (-7%, down (drag))
   • AOV: 1,280 → 1,107 EGP (-14%, down (drag))
   *Who moved it:* *AOV 59%* of the move (hurt, -166,253 EGP)  ·  *CVR 30%* of the move (hurt, -81,063 EGP)  ·  *CPC 12%* of the move (hurt, -6,407 EGP).
   *Read:* *AOV* fell -14%, the biggest of the three.
     Worth about *-166,253 EGP of revenue*.
     That drove ROAS -22%.
     Revenue -12% because spend +12%.
   *Deeper:* biggest single mover was *w26 retention*, its AOV went 1542.12 EGP→882.65 EGP on 3,183 EGP spend (~11% of the swing).
